idea-plugin.name: Excalidraw Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Excalidraw Editor is an unofficial JetBrains IDE plugin for opening and editing .excalidraw files directly inside IntelliJ-based IDEs.

The plugin adds a custom editor tab backed by JCEF and the official @excalidraw/excalidraw React package, so Excalidraw drawings can be viewed and edited without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Registers .excalidraw files as a custom file type.
  • Opens .excalidraw files in an embedded Excalidraw editor.
  • Loads existing Excalidraw JSON from the opened file.
  • Syncs scene changes back into the IDE document.
  • Supports normal IDE save behavior, including Save and Save All.
  • Bundles the Excalidraw frontend locally, with no cloud sync or collaboration dependency.

MVP Scope

  • No cloud sync.
  • No collaboration features.
  • No image export yet.
  • No marketplace-specific account integration.

This plugin is free, open source, and unofficial. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with Excalidraw.
